item.title: Bulletin updated at 16:30 HKT 19/Feb/2025
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Under the influence of a fresh to strong northeast monsoon, it will be cool in the morning over the coast of Guangdong in the next couple of days. A replenishment of the monsoon will reach the coast of southern China on Sunday. The weather will be rather cool over the region on Monday. The monsoon is expected to moderate gradually midweek next week. Meanwhile, a band of clouds will bring a few rain patches to southern China.
